conditions.angularOrigin: specified inertial origin; also report intrinsic COM angular momentum
conditions.forceCaveat: Float32 force and accumulation roundoff must be measured; Float64 readback diagnostics do not upgrade the trajectory precision.

conventions.massQuantiles: inverse empirical mass CDF; no rank interpolation
conventions.potential: not evaluated; provide current specificPotential explicitly
conventions.virial: W_ij = sum m r_i a_j from caller supplied current field; surface terms not estimated
conventions.overflowBins: upper=null includes all radii above the last edge; density is undefined there
conventions.cylindricalAxis: R=0 particles omitted from cylindrical velocity moments only

meta.initialization: AGAMA action DF in self-consistent Plummer mean field
meta.qualification: Candidate; successful DF preparation is not N-body stability validation

physicalModel.source: MASSAS_VIA_LACTEA_1_0.md; Cautun et al. 2020 uncontracted NFW reference; explicit reduced model

config.branch: Cautun et al. 2020 Table 2, uncontracted NFW column; reduced collisionless approximation, not a refit
config.kinematicChoice: 35 and 50 km/s at solar radius are explicit thin/thick population priors for sensitivity, not fitted C20 kinematics; no tuning against evolved stability
config.method: Fixed action DFs + Plummer mean-field self-consistent iteration
config.qualification: Mass uncertainties are marginal intervals, not independent draws. R=207 kpc is the reference paper radius, not a new measured R200 of the gas-free model. Disk Hdisk is an action DF parameter and does not impose the reference double-exponential density. Bulge sphericalization and finite halo taper change profiles. Final profiles and enclosed masses must be measured. Vertical DF parameter calibrated to the declared initial exponential median at solar radius; iteration seed changes only convergence speed, not fixed DFs.

calibration.target: median |z| of reference exponential at solar radius, before SCM
calibration.qualification: Fixed spatial target, no dynamical cooling. Final SCM density must be checked again; no exact fit of the full exponential profile is asserted.

physicalModel.haloExtent: Gaussian cutoff, noncompact support; no hard radius

admissibility.normalization: fixed independent action-space DF integral; equal M/N weights
fixed independent action-space DF integral; equal M/N weights
fixed independent action-space DF integral; equal M/N weights
fixed independent action-space DF integral; equal M/N weights

softenedMean.densityConvention: physical DF density; Poisson density is convolved
softenedMean.evolution: Unmodified pairwise Plummer KDK; no cooling or live correction

version104.qualification: Unvaried blocks copied; changed populations resampled from same fixed action DFs in unchanged converged Plummer mean; no clones or velocity rescaling.

version105.qualification: Only selected population resampled; no clones or changes of unvaried phase blocks. Halo campaign fixes every baryon to seed2026; seed variation in halo only.
